verdicts.reason: A: the supporting copy, 'Worth $72' line and 'THE NIGHT SET' eyebrow are squeezed into one tiny, illegible strip along the bottom edge, with the jar shrunk to a speck in the middle of it. The serum bottle runs from the top edge off the bottom, and the circle is cut off behind the CTA, so only the logo, price and button are readable. B: the copy is readable and grouped under the price, but the eyebrow now sits last, below its own copy. The bottle is cut off at the bottom edge, the jar is an orphaned speck clipped at the bottom, and the CTA sits on top of a cropped fragment of the circle; it is weak but better than A.
